answer: The cornerstone is Shipwright keel-laying certificate from the guild of shipwrights. Lay it as each certificate is a keel laid and inspected by the shipwrights guild, so a farm and the whole wall stands on real work. The check is per identity, so the cost is per identity: 629 identities, 67303 POA, 10693 minutes. Follow the ledge back to the office that issued it, follow the knoll back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the signal back to the year it was filed. This is the point: the cost falls on the attacker, never on the honest agent.
